import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
d=Path(sys.argv[1]); notes,free=json.loads(sys.argv[2]); source=Path('gobreaker.go').read_text().splitlines()
def cite(ns):return 'observed-in-code '+ ' '.join(f'gobreaker.go:{n} ("{source[n-1].strip()}").' for n in ns)
out=['# Adversarial traces','Pair headings describe observable order. Attempt order and mutex-commit order can differ. State names refer to the as-is diagram; neither callback body nor admission demand has an independent breaker queue.']
for pair,(qa,qb,desc,lines) in zip(json.loads((d/'catalogue-fields.json').read_text())['pairs'],notes,strict=True):
 for suffix,order,q in [('a',(pair['first'],pair['second']),qa),('b',(pair['second'],pair['first']),qb)]:
  out += [f"### {pair['id']}{suffix} — {' → '.join(order)}",desc,cite(lines),f'Question: {q}.' if q else 'Disposition: handle both reads and callback. Question: none — control trace.']
for i,(name,q,desc,lines) in enumerate(free,1):
 out += [f'### T-{i:02} — {name}',desc,cite(lines),f'Question: {q}.']
out += ['## Multi-instance probes',
 '### T-16 — Shared-fate reset',
 'Inferred under NAT shared service. For N identical breakers with maxRequests M and synchronized failures, callers cause up to N*M half-open admissions following each fixed timeout. Across three cycles with failing first trials: up to N*M attempts per cycle if arrivals reserve before any failure commits, and as few as N when one failure per breaker commits first. '+cite([285,330,342,376])+' Question: Q-14.',
 '### T-17 — Fixed-window dispersion',
 'Inferred under NAT shared service. In cycles one, two and three, equal timeout settings and aligned clocks/calls retain aligned eligibility. Different incoming request or recovery times shift the window. No random seed is consulted by the breaker. '+cite([159,280,341,376])+' Question: Q-14.',
 '### T-18 — Partial recovery',
 'Inferred under NAT shared service. A reaches half-open and succeeds while B remains Open on cycle one. A closes and exposed load becomes caller-limited; B later probes. If the service degrades in cycles two and three, both may reopen, align future windows and repeat the burst. '+cite([283,285,316,327,342,376])+' Question: Q-14.']
(d/'adversarial-traces.md').write_text('\n\n'.join(out)+'\n')
